Day 1 on Verdel Ridge. 🪖
Yesterday they were strangers. Tonight 32 of them hold the line: 18 for the Hegemony, 14 for the Concord.

⚔️ THE RACE FOR VERDEL RIDGE
First side to 100 soldiers takes the heights: 3 days of artillery on the enemy, a safer week for every soldier who fought, and the title of Hero for the recruit who tips the balance.

📰 Every morning at 13:00 UTC the Trench Gazette prints what happened on the line. If your name is in it, you were there.

Every friend you bring is one more rifle.
🩶 comment HEGEMONY · 🫒 comment CONCORD

variants.caption:
🩶 VERDEL RIDGE HAS FALLEN. Now your side votes: comment FORTIFY or HOSPITAL below 👇

The Hegemony reached 100 soldiers first ({win} against {lose}) and took the heights. The deciding rifle belonged to @{hero}, now Hero of Verdel Ridge. 🎖️

For 3 days the guns on the ridge pound the Concord lines. For a week the high ground keeps the Hegemony safer. Every Hegemony soldier wears the ribbon.

🗳️ NOW EACH SIDE CHOOSES WHAT TO BUILD

🧱 FORTIFY: sandbag parapets, fewer men hit

items.caption:
🩸 DAY 2: FIRST BLOOD ON VERDEL RIDGE

The big guns are still silent. The rifles are not. Five men were hit overnight.

🩶 HEGEMONY: 3 hit
• @0__freddie__0 badly wounded, shot by @ghai.gpt of the Concord. Now in a bed at the aid post.
• @slightlyretarded69 grazed, shot by @leo.glc
• @wolfmanantony grazed, shot by @csllgaks

🫒 CONCORD: 2 hit
• @pavla.9_ and @the_cowboii grazed by stray bullets

Each side has only an aid post with 2 beds. When they fill, the badly wounded wait on stretchers in the mud. No side has a hospital yet.
🗳️ Today at 15:00 UTC each side votes what to build. Watch this account.

Read the Trench Gazette and find your soldier: link in bio.

NEW ON THE FRONT 🪖

🎯 Every rifle on the line is a real player, and now every shot can hit one. Hit someone and it goes in both your service records.
⚔️ Ten trades: snipers, machine gunners, stretcher bearers, sappers, cooks… every one of them matters.
🎖️ Every day at the front makes you better: Recruit → Seasoned → Veteran → Elite.
🏥 The badly wounded need a bed. Each side has an aid post with only two. Follow the red cross on the map.
🗳️ Each side votes what to build: HOSPITAL or SANDBAGS. Vote under our latest post.
🕯️ Fall, and your house fights on. Your heir takes the rifle.
🏅 Longest alive, best shots, oldest houses: it's all in the Ranks.
